statement: ∀ (x : ℝ), (∃ k, -x = x + ↑k * (2 * Real.pi)) ↔ ∃ m, x = ↑m * Real.pi
script:
# name: set-neg-congruent-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Equivalence.neg_congruent_iff
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0'], True, 'have key : ∀ (x : ℝ), (∃ k : ℤ, -x = x + k * (2 * Real.pi)) ↔ ∃ m : ℤ, x = m * Real.pi := by
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩; exact ⟨-k, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨-m, by push_cast; ring⟩
exact @key (0)'),
    (['Real.pi'], False, 'have key : ∀ (x : ℝ), (∃ k : ℤ, -x = x + k * (2 * Real.pi)) ↔ ∃ m : ℤ, x = m * Real.pi := by
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩; exact ⟨-k, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨-m, by push_cast; ring⟩
exact @key (Real.pi)'),
    (['1'], False, 'have key : ∀ (x : ℝ), (∃ k : ℤ, -x = x + k * (2 * Real.pi)) ↔ ∃ m : ℤ, x = m * Real.pi := by
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩; exact ⟨-k, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨-m, by push_cast; ring⟩
exact @key (1)'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]

goal.text: (∃ k, -x = x + ↑k * (2 * Real.pi)) ↔ ∃ m, x = ↑m * Real.pi
